stories.title: Independent Australian MP Helen Haines is critically injured in what police call a 'deliberate' car ramming
stories.reason: A Toyota Land Cruiser struck the 65-year-old outside her Wangaratta electorate office and a knife was later seized from the vehicle, prompting PM Albanese to say 'this wasn't an accident' and the national counterterrorism team to join the investigation.

stories.title: The 2026 US midterms are on track to become the most expensive ever, with more than $15 billion raised
stories.reason: Separate trackers put aired ad spending at a record $3.8 billion so far, while Democrats hold a fundraising edge in 13 of 21 House 'toss up' races even as Elon Musk remains the cycle's single biggest known donor.

stories.title: Human Rights Watch says Malian forces and their Russian partners killed 94 civilians in drone strikes this year
stories.reason: ACLED-sourced data cited in the report counts 47 strikes from April to August, more than double last year's toll, including an August 19 strike on a Bandiagara cattle market that killed six men that HRW calls 'apparent indiscriminate' targeting.

stories.title: Consumer backlash over AI-driven 'surveillance pricing' pushes bills in more than 30 state legislatures
stories.reason: The National Conference of State Legislatures counts at least 30 states considering algorithmic and personalized-pricing bills as Walmart defends its electronic shelf labels, while the FTC separately warns retailers that undisclosed personal-data pricing could violate consumer law.

stories.title: Anthropic acquires confidential-computing AI startup Opaque Systems and hires its CEO and CTO
stories.reason: Opaque, a UC Berkeley RISELab spinout last valued at $300 million with Anthropic, ServiceNow and Accenture as customers, is winding down as a company while its 'verifiable AI' technology and leadership move to Anthropic.

stories.title: Three undocumented 'aurora' model IDs briefly appear in OpenAI's API, then vanish without explanation
stories.reason: OpenAI has published no pricing, documentation or release date for aurora-red-alpha, aurora-green-alpha and aurora-blue-alpha, and reports disagree on whether they are new image generators or high-speed GPT-6 inference variants.

stories.title: Chip stocks snap their longest losing streak in 18 years as the Nasdaq rebounds roughly 1.8%
stories.reason: Intel, Nvidia, AMD and Micron all posted notable gains as easing Treasury yields and a Goldman Sachs upgrade of CoreWeave helped stabilize a semiconductor index that had shed roughly $2 trillion in value over eight straight losing sessions.

stories.title: A truck plows through a youth soccer game in Wichita, Kansas, killing a 6-year-old boy and a 35-year-old man
stories.reason: The 34-year-old driver, who had a child playing on another field at the Stryker Sports Complex, was released without charges pending toxicology results, as police say they have interviewed more than 30 witnesses to the Saturday crash.
